name: selectionfragility: Decision Breakdown Point and Selection-Fragility Diagnostics for Forecast Model Comparison
description: Decision-oriented diagnostics for forecast model selection: the Model Confidence Set (Hansen, Lunde and Nason 2011) for identification of the best model, and the decision breakdown point (k*), the fewest evaluation periods whose deletion flips the pooled winner. Includes selection-as-election diagnostics (score vs plurality vs Condorcet winners, cycles vs ties, margin concentration) and a staged pipeline from a validated loss panel through identification, resolution, significance certification, pivot analysis, and run-over-run comparison. A native R port of the Python package selection-fragility.
